name: Multi Connect
author: Daniel Ruiz

sections.description:
Multi Connect allows you to connect your WordPress site to the Multi platform for centralized management and updates. This plugin serves as a secure bridge between your WordPress installation and the Multi dashboard.

For more information, visit Multi WP

Key Features:

  • Centralized site management
  • Secure connection to Multi Wp platform
  • Easy updates management
  • Site monitoring capabilities
  • Streamlined maintenance
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/multi-connect directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Visit the Multi Connect settings page to configure your connection.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin secure?

Yes, Multi Connect uses secure authentication methods and encrypted communications to ensure your site’s security.

What WordPress versions are supported?

The plugin supports WordPress 5.8 and above.
